description: A precisely composed exterior landscape vignette photographed at dusk or early evening with a cool blue-gray twilight sky. The scene shows the edge of a manicured residential front garden alongside a wide light gray concrete or stone walkway path. The lawn grass is a dense fine-blade turf in deep green, the blades catching the ground-level light with a vivid luminous green. Behind the lawn, a curated landscape planting bed contains low mounding shrubs, ornamental grasses with soft feathery seed heads rising in the right middle ground, and a variety of groundcover plants — the garden is lush but well-maintained. The background shows the lower facade of a modern residence — smooth light beige or off-white plaster exterior wall with a continuous horizontal linear glow of warm amber light emanating from the recessed eave or fascia, creating a bright warm strip of architectural light across the full building face. Trees are silhouetted in the upper background. A semi-circular arch-shaped low-profile ground-level fixture is set at the edge of the grass, its inner face emitting a bright cool-white to neutral light downward and forward — casting a broad wash of light across the adjacent grass, clearly illuminating several square feet of lawn in the immediate vicinity. The fixture body itself is a simple dark charcoal or dark gray arc form, nearly flush with the ground. The overall mood is serene, contemporary, and minimal. Camera is at very low eye-level, wide-normal lens, off-center composition with the fixture in the right third of the frame and the walkway in the lower left. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
